items.title: Manila Times runs AFP wire on Demna's 'complete personal vision' Gucci show
items.summary: Filipino daily republishes AFP's report on Demna's sophomore Gucci collection at Milan Fashion Week, describing hooded menswear with tartan-lined jackets and cropped trousers alongside 1980s-Milanese womenswear with midriff cutouts. Notes Gucci sales kept declining through Q2 2026 though the pace of decline slowed versus Q1, a modestly positive signal buried in otherwise design-focused coverage.

items.title: MEGA flags Gucci's 'The Store Show' SS27 livestream at 8PM Philippine time
items.summary: The Philippines' MEGA magazine previews Demna's SS27 presentation, branded 'The Store Show,' timestamped for local viewers, following his February debut and Cruise 2027 Times Square event. Purely promotional/access-oriented framing aimed at SEA fashion audiences rather than critical review.

items.title: WWD review: Gucci Spring 2027 'Store Show' built a full boutique as runway
items.summary: WWD's trade review of Demna's third Gucci collection describes a life-size mock flagship store staging statement coats, oversized sunglasses and 'more-is-more' glamour, calling it the designer's first full articulation of his creative vision for the house after roughly a year in the role. Relevant to SEA retail buyers assessing what merchandise direction to expect in regional boutiques.

items.title: SCMP: Gucci and Prada keep closing China/APAC outlets as Kering targets Asia saturation
items.summary: Critical-angle business piece reports Gucci and Prada have each closed additional China/APAC outlets (SCMP names two Shanghai Gucci closures), with a Morningstar analyst quoted on consumers pulling back on discretionary luxury spend. Frames continued regional retail contraction as a headwind that also shapes SEA distribution strategy even though the named closures are concentrated in NEA markets. Note: broader figures on total 2025/2026 closure counts and any Kering-executive statement on Asia saturation could not be independently verified against the source and are treated as 미확인 (unconfirmed).

items.title: Weibo finance posts dissect Gucci's rare 30-40% price cuts on bestsellers
items.summary: Chinese-language finance/commentary accounts on Weibo discuss Gucci's unusual permanent price reduction (Mercato tote roughly -22%, Ophidia mini bucket bag over -40%), framed as breaking the luxury-sector taboo of 'only raising, never cutting' prices; posts speculate on knock-on effects for regional pricing parity and resale value across Asia, relevant to SEA cross-border shoppers who benchmark China pricing. Engagement counts not visible via web view.

items.title: Fashion forum thread: posters call Gucci FW26/27 campaign disconnected from the runway, some say 'Gucci is dead'
items.summary: Long-running enthusiast forum thread on Gucci's FW2026/27 campaign (Michal Chelbin, shot in Zagreb) shows a majority-critical tone -- one poster wrote the campaign is 'so insipid' they'd call 'Gucci... dead' -- alongside a minority who called it Demna's 'most interesting' work yet. Included as the clearest available critical community discussion despite being slightly outside the tightest freshness window; kept because it captures ongoing enthusiast sentiment about brand direction still being referenced as the new Sept 25 show dropped.

items.title: Dazed: Demna 'hits shuffle' on Italian stereotypes for Gucci SS27
items.summary: Culture-magazine review reads the Store Show as Demna cycling through exaggerated Italian archetypes (tanned playboy, Milanese socialite, young bombshell), a more youth-culture-oriented critical lens than the trade press, useful for gauging how the collection may land with SEA's younger luxury-adjacent social audience.
